title: Invoice paid
description: An invoice was paid: a verified Stripe payment succeeded and the wallet was credited by the invoice total (the Postpaid debt was paid off), or the invoice documents a charge the wallet had already paid. A browser redirect never causes it. This schema describes the `data` member of the delivered document; the envelope (id, type, tenantId, occurredAt, data) is described in README.md.

settlement.description: PAYMENT when a verified payment paid it; WALLET when the wallet had already paid the charge.

paymentId.description: The payment that paid the invoice. Absent when the wallet had already paid.

money.description: An amount in minor units (cents, dong) of one ISO 4217 currency.
